transcript: Speaker A: Hate to be the one to tell you this, but you are literally wasting so much time every single week on typing. I know it sounds silly, but hear me out because I literally saved like 5 hours last week on this alone. Write me a meal prep plan for the next few days and then give me, um, some ideas for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. It put exactly what I said into a properly formulated sentence with no ums, no errors. You can use this on email, text, ChatGPT, whatever you want. It will literally save your life. It's called Whisper Flow. Thank me later.
